potatoes: We dug up some potatoes from the vegetable patch.

probably: I am not sure, but she is probably at the library.

remember: Can you remember where we left the football?

sentence: A full stop goes at the end of every sentence.

surprise: Finding a frog in my boot was a big surprise.

thought: He had a thought about how to mend the broken kite.
